761410102.text: But it's not time for a drawn-out, deeply emotional, tearful goodbye just yet... After all, you haven't finished your tour of my little lodge.

761410103.text: But Paimon could swear we've been in all the rooms already?

761410104.text: Well, I never actually said there were no secret hidden rooms, did I? Us mages like our little fancies, you know — you should be used to this by now!

761410201.text: As one of the fixed observation points for changes in the world, I require it to have excellent visibility. Just as a sculptor needs a chisel, a writer needs both pen and ink...

761410202.text: My achievements in those two fields of art may well be up for debate, but when it comes to my main line of work, I take things very seriously indeed.

761410203.text: #The "fate" of Teyvat has been shaken more and more frequently as of late. I'm sure you've felt it too, {NICKNAME}.

761410204.text: Sometimes I can't help but think, if I still had the form, power, and abilities I once possessed, I'd be able to do so much more than I can right now.

761410205.text: But I soon shake those thoughts from my head. If things were how they were before, I'd have so many more restrictions placed on me by the heavens.

761410206.text: The thought of having that many things I can't even talk about makes it seem like a terrible trade-off. I mean, how would I tell stories without the freedom to say what I want?

761410207.text: That's why I've never once regretted the price I paid, or any of the choices I've taken.

761410208.text: I wanted to become human, to live like a regular person... but such a life is a luxury. I can't forget that I am an angel.

761410209.text: Even if I were stuck being an angel in silence, I'd still fulfill my duties — defending civilization, defending life...

761410210.text: Oh dear, have I started talking too seriously again? Perhaps it's because of where we are...

761410211.text: I'm actually quite happy with my angelic side. You could even say I'm proud of it.

761410212.text: So you should be! You don't get involved much, but when you do, we all know we're in safe hands.

761410214.text: You really feel that way? Hehe, as long as you see me as someone to rely on, then I know I'm doing a fantastic job!

761410215.text: It's getting late. Here, take my blessings and continue on your adventure.

761410216.text: Never be afraid of losing your way, and never forget you have an angel watching over you.

761410501.text: I understand if you want to stay a while. After all, the scenery here exists only in my memories — you won't find it anywhere else.

761419902.text: Nicole, did you use your magic to transport us somewhere else again?

761419903.text: Hehe, of course not, Paimon. You're still very much in my lodge — but who's to say my lodge can't also contain this beautiful world?
